map.根据皮肤光型、紫外线强度和户外时间，计算所需 SPF/PA 等级与防晒保护时长: Based on skin phototype, UV intensity and outdoor time, calculate the needed SPF/PA level and sun protection duration.
map.📖 查看「防晒系数 (SPF/PA) 计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Sunscreen Factor (SPF/PA) Calculator User Guide"
map.有效 MED = MED × 5 / UVI；理论保护时间 = 有效 MED ×: Effective MED = MED × 5 / UVI; theoretical protection time = effective MED × SPF; actual protection time = theoretical × activity factor; required SPF = ⌈outdoor time / (effective MED × activity factor)⌉
map.UVI 以 5 为基准校正（UVI 越高有效 MED 越短）。活动系数反映出汗/: UVI is corrected against a baseline of 5 (higher UVI shortens effective MED). The activity factor reflects sweat / water wash-off weakening sunscreen. UVA protection time = effective MED × PPD × activity factor; PPD by PA level: PA+ 3, PA++ 6, PA+++ 12, PA++++ 20. Recommended SPF: need ≤15 → SPF 15+, ≤30 → SPF 30+, ≤50 → SPF 50+, otherwise SPF 50+ (needs physical cover + reapplication); recommended PA: UVI ≤2 → PA++, ≤5 → PA+++, >5 → PA++++. Used for outdoor sunscreen specs and reapplication interval.
map.⚠️ SPF 计算基于理论值，实际防护受涂抹量（需 2mg/cm²）、出汗、摩擦: ⚠️ SPF calculation is theoretical; real protection is affected by application amount (need 2 mg/cm²), sweat and friction. Adequate application + timed reapplication is key.
map.旅行规划：按目的地紫外线指数与停留时长反推需要的 SPF/PA 与用量。: Travel planning: back-calculate the needed SPF/PA and amount from the destination UV index and stay duration.
map.母婴防晒：估算儿童面部小面积所需用量，避免过量或不足。: Parent-child sun care: estimate the small facial amount a child needs, avoiding excess or shortfall.
map.教学演示：向顾客解释「为什么标称 SPF50 实际可能只到 SPF20」。: Teaching demo: explain to customers 'why labeled SPF50 may actually only reach SPF20'.
map.输入：UVI 8、户外 3h、用量足额 → 建议 SPF50+ PA++++ 并: Input: UVI 8, 3 h outdoors, full amount → recommend SPF50+ PA++++ and reapply every 2 h, immediately after water exit.
map.阴天需要防晒吗？: Do I need sunscreen on a cloudy day?
map.需要。云层挡不住全部 UV-A，长期累积仍致光老化。: Yes. Clouds don't block all UVA; long-term accumulation still causes photo-aging.
map.通常不够量。粉底/隔离用量远低，建议先涂足量防晒再上妆。: Usually not enough. Foundation / primer amounts are far lower; apply adequate sunscreen first, then makeup.
map.本工具给的是医嘱吗？: Does this tool give medical advice?
map.不是。结果仅为用量与参数的估算参考，特殊肤质请遵医嘱。: No. Results are only estimates of amount and parameters; follow your doctor for special skin.
